cwe_assessments.review_comment: The patch adds essential host validation for user-controlled redirect URLs in the logout view. The is_safe_url function validates that the next_page parameter only redirects to the current host, preventing open redirect attacks. This security control ensures that logout redirects cannot be exploited to redirect users to malicious external sites. Ensure is_safe_url implements comprehensive validation including protocol restrictions and proper host matching.
